stem:
Krish's family wants to use less petrol, diesel, and coal this month.

Which claims correctly reduce fossil-fuel use? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Walk or cycle for nearby trips instead of taking a short car ride.
Share a bus or train for longer trips so fewer cars burn petrol.
Cut back on solar-panel use so that sunlight does not run out.
Always pick the smallest car, because the smallest vehicle must use the least fossil fuel for every trip.

teacher.key_rationale: Walking, cycling, and shared public transport cut petrol and diesel use. Limiting solar use mistakes a renewable source for a fossil fuel, and size alone does not prove lower fuel use for every trip.
